categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the pump business, focusing on canned motor pumps, metering pumps, and other specialized pumps. It also has a minor segment for special equipment, such as permanent magnet generators. The electronic components business was discontinued at the end of 2024, leaving the pump business as the core segment, accounting for over 95% of consolidated sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Teikoku Electric's core technology is its proprietary canned motor pump, which features a completely leak-free structure. The company emphasizes in-house development and manufacturing, including design, production, and quality control. Production methods include custom, order-based manufacturing to meet specific customer requirements, and the company holds numerous patents related to its pump technologies and manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The main customers are in the chemical, petrochemical, energy, semiconductor, and power generation industries, with a strong focus on applications where safety and leak prevention are critical. The company also serves markets related to decarbonization, such as renewable energy and LNG infrastructure. Major end users include large industrial corporations and plant operators, with Mitsubishi Electric being a notable customer.
categories.geographic_coverage: Teikoku Electric operates globally, with significant sales in Japan, Asia (notably China), the Americas (especially the United States), and Europe. It has manufacturing and sales subsidiaries in the US, China, Taiwan, Singapore, Korea, Germany, and India, enabling both local production and after-sales service in key international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned as a midstream to downstream supplier, manufacturing finished pumps and related equipment for direct sale to industrial end users and plant operators. It manages its own production and also sources components from wholly owned subsidiaries and external suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company is focusing on expanding its global production scale, shortening lead times, and strengthening its position in the decarbonization market. R&D priorities include developing pumps for clean energy applications (such as LNG and ammonia), improving pump efficiency, and collaborating with external research institutions. The company is also investing in digital transformation and human capital development to support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of custom-engineered pumps and related equipment, as well as after-sales services such as maintenance and repairs. The company also earns revenue from special equipment sales and, to a lesser extent, from licensing and consulting related to its proprietary technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Teikoku Electric is a leading global player in the canned motor pump market, recognized as a technology leader with a long-standing reputation for reliability and safety. The market includes several global competitors and emerging entrants, but Teikoku differentiates itself through its extensive track record, technical expertise, and comprehensive service network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached approximately 30.5 billion yen, with operating profit of 6.1 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 3.8 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady growth, with a 4.5% year-on-year increase in sales and a 24% increase in operating profit. The medium-term plan targets sales of 32 billion yen by FY2027 and a long-term vision of 70 billion yen by 2035.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Teikoku Electric emphasizes the safety, reliability, and environmental friendliness of its canned motor pumps, which are completely leak-free and suitable for hazardous or high-value fluids. The company highlights its ability to provide custom solutions, rapid and attentive service, and a global support network. Its strong reputation, technical know-how, and focus on sustainability and decarbonization further differentiate it from competitors.
